about.heading: I build software for whatever problem I find interesting.
about.paragraph1: I'm Manu Catalin-Gabriel, a Computer and Information Technology (CTI) student at ETTI Bucharest (POLITEHNICA University). I build web applications, experiment with machine learning, and create multi-platform software for whatever challenge I find interesting — from media streaming apps on Android to intelligent systems on the web.
about.paragraph2: I'm actively looking for software engineering roles and internships where I can bring hands-on project experience, fast learning, and strong engineering fundamentals to real-world products.

contact.heading: Have a problem worth building for?
contact.description: I read everything. Write to me about work, experiments, or an idea that doesn't fit anywhere else.
